entities.summary: Lieutenant-General Sir Thomas Jacomb Hutton, was a British Army officer who held a variety of vital staff appointments between the First and Second World Wars, ultimately commanding the Burma Army during the early stages of the Japanese conquest of Burma in early 1942.
